item.title: Integrated Care and Public Health
item.content:encoded:
This call invites submissions exploring the intersection of integrated care approaches and public health perspectives. The special issue seeks contributions that examine how coordinated and collaborative healthcare systems can address population-level health outcomes and community needs.

Appel publié par Public Health. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
